steps.en: Scaffold a project (SvelteKit by default, or plain Vite) and start the dev server
steps.zh: 生成项目（默认带 SvelteKit，也可用纯 Vite），启动开发服务器
steps.code: npx sv create myapp · npm create vite@latest

steps.en: Write a .svelte file: markup, a script block and a style block
steps.zh: 写一个 .svelte 文件：标记、script 块和 style 块放在一起

steps.en: Declare the values that change as reactive state
steps.zh: 把会变的值声明成响应式状态

steps.en: At build time, compiles each component into JS that builds its DOM and tracks which node reads which state
steps.zh: 构建时把每个组件编译成 JS：建好 DOM，记住哪个节点读了哪个状态

steps.en: Scopes the component's CSS so it cannot leak to other components
steps.zh: 把组件的 CSS 限定在组件内部，不会漏到别处

steps.en: When state changes in the browser, updates only the DOM nodes that read it — no virtual DOM diff
steps.zh: 浏览器里状态一变，只更新读了它的 DOM 节点，不做虚拟 DOM 比对

value.en: Components written close to plain HTML ship as small direct-DOM JavaScript, with no framework runtime diffing on every update
value.zh: 写法接近普通 HTML 的组件，发布成直接操作 DOM 的小段 JavaScript，更新时没有框架在后台比对

sources: https://svelte.dev/docs/svelte/getting-started (npx sv create myapp; npm create vite@latest with the svelte option)
https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte#what-is-svelte (compiler that converts components into JavaScript that surgically updates the DOM)
